description: This file defines a Kotlin class 'MainTvFragment' for an Android TV app, which displays groups of live sports matches using Leanback library components. It handles data observation, builds UI rows grouped by league, and manages user interactions such as clicking on match cards to navigate to detailed views. The file also includes a custom presenter for match cards optimized for TV navigation.

classes.name: MainTvFragment
classes.description: Fragment displaying rows of live matches, grouped by league, with click handling for match details.

classes.name: MatchCardPresenter
classes.description: Custom presenter for displaying match information as cards suitable for TV focus and navigation.

methods.name: MainTvFragment.onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, sets up UI components, data repository, and observers.

methods.name: MainTvFragment.observeMatches
methods.description: Launches a coroutine to collect live match updates and rebuild UI rows.

methods.name: MainTvFragment.buildRows
methods.description: Builds and updates UI rows based on the list of matches, grouped by league.

methods.name: MainTvFragment.ItemClickedListener.onItemClicked
methods.description: Handles user clicks on match cards, navigating to detailed match activity with relevant data.

methods.name: MatchCardPresenter.onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates an ImageCardView for displaying match info.

methods.name: MatchCardPresenter.onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds match data to the card view, loading images with fallbacks.

methods.name: MatchCardPresenter.onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Clears images from the view when unbinding.
